title: Advance Preparation
caption: Advanced Preparation (V)
game_text:
USED: Once per game, deploy Attack Run, Death Star: Trench, and/or one proton torpedoes from under your Starting Effect. {icon:immune-sense}
LOST: Retrieve 1 Force. OR If One In A Million on table, retrieve any one card.
lore: Early warning and careful planning allow the Rebels to achieve maximum readiness while still maintaining optimal flexibility.
